title: NHL Hockey
description: The Vancouver Canucks host the New York Rangers in NHL regular-season play at Rogers Arena. New York leads the season series 1-0 after beating Vancouver 6-2 in its last meeting behind goals from Will Cuylle. Vancouver relies on Elias Pettersson.

title: Live: NHL Hockey
description: The Chicago Blackhawks host the Winnipeg Jets in NHL regular-season play at the United Center. Winnipeg make the return trip to Chicago after dropping a 4-3 decision there on Oct. 15, while the Jets having won three of the last five meetings overall.

title: Live: NHL Hockey
description: The Toronto Maple Leafs host the Edmonton Oilers in NHL regular-season play at Scotiabank Arena. Toronto have won four of the last five meetings, including a 7-2 rout in Edmonton just three weeks ago. Connor McDavid leads Edmonton in points.

title: Live: NHL Hockey
description: The Los Angeles Kings host the Calgary Flames in NHL regular-season play at crypto.com Arena. Calgary have won four of the last five meetings between these Pacific Division rivals, including a 3-1 victory in the most recent clash.
